meta.title: Mauro Gerardi — Front-End Developer & Business Analyst — CV (EN)
meta.subject: Curriculum Vitae

summary: Front-End Developer and Business Analyst with 5+ years at Leafnoise Company S.A., building SaaS products (Moorea) and Argentine public-sector platforms (COMPR.AR / CONTRAT.AR). I ship accessible, responsive interfaces in React, TypeScript and Angular, and turn business processes into clear requirements for Scrum teams. In 2026 I designed, built and launched two products solo: Abril Vet and Carili Design.

skills.items: React 19, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Angular + Angular Material, Vite, React Router, i18next, responsive and accessible UI
Node.js, .NET / ASP.NET (C#), REST APIs, SQL (MySQL), MongoDB, Firebase (Auth, Firestore, security rules), Vercel Functions, Cloudinary, Mercado Pago API, Resend
Git / GitHub, GitHub Actions CI, Vitest + Testing Library, ESLint, Lighthouse / axe, Vercel
Business-process analysis, functional specs and user stories, backlog management, Scrum (Product Owner / Scrum Master), stakeholder liaison, incident management

experience.description: Software company: SaaS products (Moorea) and public-sector platforms (ONC, ANSES, Province of Santa Fe).

roles.title: Front-End Developer
bullets: Build and maintain the front end of Leafnoise's SaaS products in React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.
Own features from UX design to release: component architecture, forms and data-heavy views, REST API integration, state management, i18n, accessibility and cross-browser/mobile QA.

roles.title: Business Analyst
bullets: Analyzed and documented customers' business processes and turned them into functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria for the Scrum team.
Bridge between stakeholders and developers, covering Product Owner and Scrum Master duties: backlog prioritization, incident management, and coordination and training of teammates.

roles.title: Tech Lead — COMPR.AR / CONTRAT.AR
bullets: Led the development team of COMPR.AR and CONTRAT.AR, Argentina's national e-procurement and public-works contracting portals (Chief of Cabinet of Ministers / National Procurement Office, ONC).
Coordinated the team's day-to-day work, incident resolution and deliveries with the client.

roles.title: Full-Stack Developer — COMPR.AR / CONTRAT.AR
bullets: Maintained and extended both portals: .NET back end, Angular Material front end and SQL database.
